ORDINANCE XCII OF
1996
SENATE (ELECTION)
(THIRD AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance further to amend the
Senate (Election) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 2nd November, 1996]
No.F.2(1)/96‑Pub., dated 2‑11‑1996.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to
amend the Senate (Election) Act, 1975 (LI of 1975), for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is
not in session and the President is satisfied that the circumstances exist
which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
1. Short title and commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may
be called the Senate (Election) (Third Amendment) Ordinance, 1996.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 11, Act LI of 1975

ORDINANCE XCII OF 1996
ORDINANCE XCII OF
1996
SENATE (ELECTION)
(THIRD AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance further to amend the
Senate (Election) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 2nd November, 1996]
No.F.2(1)/96‑Pub., dated 2‑11‑1996.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to
amend the Senate (Election) Act, 1975 (LI of 1975), for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is
not in session and the President is satisfied that the circumstances exist
which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 11, Act LI
of 1975.‑‑‑In
the Senate (Election) Act, 1975 (LI of 1975), hereinafter referred to as the
said Act, in section 11,‑‑
(1) for subsection (2), the
following shall be substituted, namely:‑‑
"(2) Every proposal shall be
made by a separate nomination paper in the prescribed form which shall be
signed by the proposer and the seconder and shall contain a declaration signed
by the candidate that‑‑
(a) he consents to the nomination
and that he is not subject to any disqualification for being or being elected
as a member;
(b) any amount of loan, advance or
credit as may be prescribed, obtained from any bank, financial institution,
cooperative society or corporate body in his own name or in the name of his
spouse or dependent children or dependent parents or any business concern owned
by him or any of the aforesaid or having ten per cent. or more or controlling
shares therein, does not remain unpaid for more than one year from the due date
or such loan, advance or credit has since been paid back before filing of the
nomination paper;
(c) no loan, advance or credit, the
amount of which may be prescribed, obtained by him, his spouse or dependent
children or dependent parents or a business concern owned by him or any of the
aforesaid or having ten per cent. or more or controlling shares therein was
written off or such amount which was written off has since been paid;
(d) he, his spouse or dependent
children or dependent parents or a business concern owned by him or any of the
aforesaid or having ten per cent. or more or controlling shares therein have
not made any default in payment of taxes for over six months of an amount as
may be prescribed;
(e) he, his spouse or dependent
children or dependent parents or a business concern owned by him or any of the
aforesaid or having ten per cent. or more or controlling shares therein have
not made any default in payment of utility expenses, including telephone, electricity,
gas and water charges, for over six months of an amount as may be prescribed;
and
(f) he belongs to a particular
political party or contesting the election independently."; and ,
(2) after subsection (5); the
following Explanation shall be added, namely:‑‑
Explanation. ‑‑For the
purposes of this section, the expression‑‑
(a) "loans, advances or
credits" shall mean the loans, advances and credits written off after the
23rd day of March, 1985; and
(b) "taxes" includes all
taxes levied by Federal, Provincial or local authorities.

Subsitution of section 25, Act LI of 1975

ORDINANCE XCII OF 1996
ORDINANCE XCII OF
1996
SENATE (ELECTION)
(THIRD AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance further to amend the
Senate (Election) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 2nd November, 1996]
No.F.2(1)/96‑Pub., dated 2‑11‑1996.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to
amend the Senate (Election) Act, 1975 (LI of 1975), for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is
not in session and the President is satisfied that the circumstances exist
which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
3. Substitution of section 25, Act
LI of 1975.‑‑In
the said Act, for section 25 the following shall be substituted, namely:‑‑
"25. Declaration of result of
election.‑‑(1) On receipt of the return of the election under
subsection (2) of section 24, the Commissioner shall call upon every candidate
securing the highest number of votes to submit on a prescribed form a statement
of assets and liabilities of his own, spouse and dependent children or
dependent parents within such period as the Commissioner may fix but not later
than seven days from the date of election.
(2) The Commissioner shall after the
date fixed for submission of statement of assets and liabilities referred to in
subsection (1), publish in the official Gazette the names of the returned
candidates:
Provided that the name of a
candidate shall not be published who fails to submit such statement.".

Insertion of new sections 25-A and 25-B, Act LI of 1975

ORDINANCE XCII OF 1996
ORDINANCE XCII OF
1996
SENATE (ELECTION)
(THIRD AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance further to amend the
Senate (Election) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 2nd November, 1996]
No.F.2(1)/96‑Pub., dated 2‑11‑1996.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to
amend the Senate (Election) Act, 1975 (LI of 1975), for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is
not in session and the President is satisfied that the circumstances exist
which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
4. Insertion of new sections 25A and
25B, Act LI of 1975.‑‑In
the said Act, after section 25, amended as aforesaid, the following new
sections shall be inserted, namely:‑‑
"25A. Inspection of statements
of assets and liabilities etc.‑‑‑ A candidate may, on an
application made to the Commissioner and on payment of such fee as may be
prescribed, be allowed to inspect the statement of assets and liabilities of a
returned candidate submitted .under subsection (1) of section 25.
(2) Copies of the statement of
assets and liabilities submitted by a returned candidate under subsection (1)
of section 25 or section 25B may cause to be supplied to any candidate,
including a candidate contesting any future election, within fifteen days from
making of an application for supply of copy in the manner and on payment of
such fee as may be prescribed.
25B. Yearly submission of statement
of assets and liabilities.‑‑In addition to statement of assets and
liabilities submitted under subsection (1) of section 25, every member shall on
a prescribed form, submit a statement of assets and, liabilities annually to
the Commissioner within one month from the end of each financial year.".

Senate (Election) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 2nd November, 1996]
No.F.2(1)/96‑Pub., dated 2‑11‑1996.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to
amend the Senate (Election) Act, 1975 (LI of 1975), for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is
not in session and the President is satisfied that the circumstances exist
which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
5. Amendment of section 34, Act LI
of 1975.‑‑In
the said Act, in section 34, for the full‑stop at the end a colon shall
be substituted and thereafter the following proviso shall be added, namely:‑‑
"Provided that in respect of
allegation of corrupt practice under sub clause (iii) of clause (c) of section
58 against a returned candidate for submitting false statement of assets and
liabilities submitted under subsection (1) of section 25, the period of forty‑five
days shall be computed from commencing day of the Senate (Election) (Second
Amendment) Ordinance, 1995 (XLV of 1995)."

ORDINANCE XCII OF

No.F.2(1)/96‑Pub., dated 2‑11‑1996.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to
amend the Senate (Election) Act, 1975 (LI of 1975), for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is
not in session and the President is satisfied that the circumstances exist

Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic

6. Amendment of section 58, Act. LI
of 1975.‑‑In
the said Act, in section 58,‑‑
(i) after clause (a), the following
new clause shall be inserted, namely:‑‑
"(aa) files a declaration under
subsection (2) of section 11 which is knowingly false;"; and
(ii) in clause (c), in sub‑clause
(ii) after the semi‑colon, the word "or" shall be added and
thereafter the following new sub‑clause shall be added, namely:‑‑
"(iii) submits a false
statement of assets and liabilities under section 25;".

Insertion of new sections 27-A  Act LI of 1975

SENATE (ELECTION)
(THIRD AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1996
An Ordinance further to amend the
Senate (Election) Act, 1975
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 2nd November, 1996]
No.F.2(1)/96‑Pub., dated 2‑11‑1996.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance made by the President is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further to
amend the Senate (Election) Act, 1975 (LI of 1975), for the purposes
hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the National Assembly is
not in session and the President is satisfied that the circumstances exist
which render it necessary to take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the
powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of the Islamic
Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the
following Ordinance:‑‑
7. Insertion of new section 75A, Act
LI of 1975.‑‑In
the said Act, after section 75, the following new section shall be inserted,
namely:‑‑
"75A. Court proceeding relating
to election expenses.‑‑The Commissioner shall direct the Returning
Officer to initiate proceeding in the appropriate Court against the person who
contravenes the provisions of section 28 or fails to comply with provisions of
section 29."
